facets.description: ClientPermissionsV2.getClientsWithPermission adds the type-level "Clients" resource name as a client ID.
AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource leaves per-client resources untyped, so getClientsWithPermission misses per-client grants.
V2 client removal leaves stale resources whose deleted-client IDs cause an NPE in AvailableRoleMappingResource.getRoleIdsWithPermissions.
getClientsWithPermission does not return the real client IDs covered by an all-clients grant, leaving that grant unrepresented.
